title: Regularized Brascamp-Lieb inequalities via Optimal Transport and Study of Equality Cases
summary: We consider regularized Brascamp-Lieb inequalities using the theory of optimal transportation, more precisely an anisotropic version of Caffarelli's contraction theorem. Furthermore, we provide a full picture concerning the issues of finiteness of the Brascamp-Lieb constant and of the existence of Gaussian extremizers.
